extra_quotes: The benchmark is the database of adsorption energies compiled by Wellendorff et al. [29].
Both models were run on a single GPU of the same type (A100 with 80 GB of memory), with the same benchmark script.
Although PFP v9 adds adsorption structures to the r2SCAN data, the validation in this technical note covers only adsorption energies on clean low-index surfaces.

Grain boundaries, heterointerfaces, stepped or reconstructed surfaces, and point defects remain to be validated, and the r2SCAN data should be extended to such configurations where the accuracy falls short.
